verdicts.reason: A blows the small logo strip up into a large white block floating beside the quote, so it competes with the headline. It also shrinks the can inside a full circle stranded at left, leaving the right and bottom thirds of the canvas dead. B keeps the original's structure: left-aligned quote and attribution, a tiny logo bottom-left, and the circle bleeding off the corner with the can. Its flaws are a shrunken quote mark, a large empty band between the attribution and the logo, and a logo that is very small at this size.
